keySentence: The family grew closer and happier.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: One month went by quickly. The family ate together every night. They told stories at the table. They planted flowers on weekends. Emma read to Ben before bed. Father and Mother held hands more. Their home was full of love. The family grew closer and happier.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: A month after Ms. Clara had arrived, something had quietly bloomed in the small cottage. Mother and Father held hands at dinner now, looking at each other the way they used to when they were young. Emma read aloud to Ben before bed, her soft voice filling his room. Together they planted new flowers in the garden each weekend, choosing colors as a team. They started small traditions — Sunday pancakes, Friday storytime, evening walks around the lane. None of it was loud or grand, but every day felt richer than the one before. The family grew closer and happier, and the cottage glowed with kindness. Ms. Clara watched it all and knew her work here was just beginning.
